scripts.build:native-windows: dotnet publish apps/windows-native/IPMessenger.Native.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o apps/windows-native/publish
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build:desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/mobile/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/models/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/networking/tsconfig.json
